Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 59, "heading": "CHAPTER 57. THE EMIGRANTS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u059-b0062", "target": "На следующее утро я снова спустился к ним, чтобы убедиться, что они уехали. Они отплыли на лодке уже в пять часов. Для меня было удивительным примером той пустоты, какую оставляют такие расставания, что, хотя мои представления о них, связанные с полуразвалившимся трактиром и деревянной лестницей, начались только со вчерашнего вечера, и то и другое казалось унылым и покинутым теперь, когда их не стало.", "source_sha256": "5dd94a2149fc9564f0123ef534c7ee5c2735662ebc0f9d769f8260da3bcdd35c", "target_id": "ru-en85-u059-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fd23d480f63b103d610b3ba59dcd4d76f8093bcbaff7e4c7687cb0f571c5598c"}, {"source_id": "en85-u059-b0063", "target": "Во второй половине следующего дня моя старая нянька и я поехали в Грейвзенд. Мы нашли корабль на реке, окружённый множеством лодок; дул попутный ветер; на верхушке мачты был поднят сигнал к отплытию. Я тотчас нанял лодку, и мы отчалили к кораблю; и, пробравшись сквозь небольшой водоворот суматохи, центром которого он был, поднялись на борт.", "source_sha256": "ae6a29711b6f65f8a351a0234627ffb24853a4500ab8a25f6de6caa4ba26fba5", "target_id": "ru-en85-u059-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2ebd0465251e91ebec331740fd09b8a71d3ac5832da55371a92b112faccf608e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 57, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u059-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Peggotty was waiting for us on deck. He told me that Mr. Micawber had just now been arrested again (and for the last time) at the suit of Heep, and that, in compliance with a request I had made to him, he had paid the money, which I repaid him. He then took us down between decks; and there, any lingering fears I had of his having heard any rumours of what had happened, were dispelled by Mr. Micawber’s coming out of the gloom, taking his arm with an air of friendship and protection, and telling me that they had scarcely been asunder for a moment, since the night before last.", "sha256": "39c328333d93295643ee3de385aec565ed14a65763664ba53343cff481f72194", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was such a strange scene to me, and so confined and dark, that, at first, I could make out hardly anything; but, by degrees, it cleared, as my eyes became more accustomed to the gloom, and I seemed to stand in a picture by OSTADE. Among the great beams, bulks, and ringbolts of the ship, and the emigrant-berths, and chests, and bundles, and barrels, and heaps of miscellaneous baggage—‘lighted up, here and there, by dangling lanterns; and elsewhere by the yellow daylight straying down a windsail or a hatchway—were crowded groups of people, making new friendships, taking leave of one another, talking, laughing, crying, eating and drinking; some, already settled down into the possession of their few feet of space, with their little households arranged, and tiny children established on stools, or in dwarf elbow-chairs; others, despairing of a resting-place, and wandering disconsolately. From babies who had but a week or two of life behind them, to crooked old men and women who seemed to have but a week or two of life before them; and from ploughmen bodily carrying out soil of England on their boots, to smiths taking away samples of its soot and smoke upon their skins; every age and occupation appeared to be crammed into the narrow compass of the ‘tween decks.", "sha256": "efdbf1067b43ff009ae8e3ef62b430d669b1d7b1535731c88cb3579ddf4cb730", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As my eye glanced round this place, I thought I saw sitting, by an open port, with one of the Micawber children near her, a figure like Emily’s; it first attracted my attention, by another figure parting from it with a kiss; and as it glided calmly away through the disorder, reminding me of—Agnes! But in the rapid motion and confusion, and in the unsettlement of my own thoughts, I lost it again; and only knew that the time was come when all visitors were being warned to leave the ship; that my nurse was crying on a chest beside me; and that Mrs. Gummidge, assisted by some younger stooping woman in black, was busily arranging Mr. Peggotty’s goods.", "sha256": "55c5404006e9c8aa9bb3b0e440d97d880fa71ec4f8f53cd4790e678b8d0f3f1a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is there any last wured, Mas’r Davy?’ said he. ‘Is there any one forgotten thing afore we parts?’", "sha256": "fba28e1eb803c8d6a2080202f4ac6c197b0dc7c1801662d4185fb23580dcd52d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘One thing!’ said I. ‘Martha!’", "sha256": "5ec4266a0042776618f453a112fcd569ef26ca8d4f55ac9c62f3dbcb60d40d1c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He touched the younger woman I have mentioned on the shoulder, and Martha stood before me.", "sha256": "e25b8fc92b9dd06e32a972d1855ca865b71a89fc00c4d0e2ff79513ebc6f3c67", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Heaven bless you, you good man!’ cried I. ‘You take her with you!’", "sha256": "721205a356886972332fd57a44363be4fb05c782aeb1c0b96fccb25e78daf77e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She answered for him, with a burst of tears. I could speak no more at that time, but I wrung his hand; and if ever I have loved and honoured any man, I loved and honoured that man in my soul.", "sha256": "436f431671a9e4d6ef7c3ad13b0c64de7b043bbc09bae6e3da8738a7d7da6e7f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The ship was clearing fast of strangers. The greatest trial that I had, remained. I told him what the noble spirit that was gone, had given me in charge to say at parting. It moved him deeply. But when he charged me, in return, with many messages of affection and regret for those deaf ears, he moved me more.", "sha256": "305cb4bce26b4555e9623c4fd476de42d6c2fbe21ac2acade38db422b6d71db0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The time was come. I embraced him, took my weeping nurse upon my arm, and hurried away. On deck, I took leave of poor Mrs. Micawber. She was looking distractedly about for her family, even then; and her last words to me were, that she never would desert Mr. Micawber.", "sha256": "18cab931042441d8d1b5721347350da92e8f2a3dc312570ecde1f09278c6a1bd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We went over the side into our boat, and lay at a little distance, to see the ship wafted on her course. It was then calm, radiant sunset. She lay between us, and the red light; and every taper line and spar was visible against the glow. A sight at once so beautiful, so mournful, and so hopeful, as the glorious ship, lying, still, on the flushed water, with all the life on board her crowded at the bulwarks, and there clustering, for a moment, bare-headed and silent, I never saw.", "sha256": "036d1abe991aa2686cc63c725d2b9ded9900583e1f480148c0a671091e42baae", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Silent, only for a moment. As the sails rose to the wind, and the ship began to move, there broke from all the boats three resounding cheers, which those on board took up, and echoed back, and which were echoed and re-echoed. My heart burst out when I heard the sound, and beheld the waving of the hats and handkerchiefs—and then I saw her!", "sha256": "5ce291e41934af7ae2838066bf7762a795687442fdf6bcdc2ff2a82e8ab770b6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[76]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0076", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Then I saw her, at her uncle’s side, and trembling on his shoulder. He pointed to us with an eager hand; and she saw us, and waved her last good-bye to me. Aye, Emily, beautiful and drooping, cling to him with the utmost trust of thy bruised heart; for he has clung to thee, with all the might of his great love!", "sha256": "1448135d402a53d603884898b6cb619a9245c533863dba19e8c6a9e4653adb19", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[77]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u059-b0077", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Surrounded by the rosy light, and standing high upon the deck, apart together, she clinging to him, and he holding her, they solemnly passed away. The night had fallen on the Kentish hills when we were rowed ashore—and fallen darkly upon me.", "sha256": "277f1979b49a0a5718abf8cd59c049e22ec3bc8318dce38be97951f87a75fecd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[64]/p[78]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
